scenario: The function form `count(t.state)` of a declared `count` aggregation (LSER.16.1: every aggregation is callable as a function in any expression position) compiles in a `where`. PINS ONLY THAT IT COMPILES. Named for the LSER.8.7 heading (multi-tier deployments), whose per-engine series state a compile cannot observe.
rules_ds:
use default

schema Sensor scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    state: Float mutable

series Sensor.state:
    count sliding 10_s

rule trig:
    Sensor t where count(t.state) > 0
->
    log info "x"
